Dear Mr. Mayer:
This letter constitutes the agreement (the "Agreement") between Philip Morris
Incorporated, a Virginia corporation with executive offices located at 120 Park Avenue, New York,
New York 10017 ("Philip Morris"), and Towers, Perrin, Forster & Crosby, Inc., a Pennsylvania
corporation with offices located at 500 Boylston Street, Boston, Massachusetts 02116-3734
("Contractor"), pursuant to which Contractor has performed and will continue to perform services
for Philip Morris under the terms and conditions stated.
Services.
In connection with Philip Morris' Places Program, Contractor will perform the
following services, as and when requested by Philip Morris:
(a) provide planning support in connection with projects designated by Philip
Morris;
(b) provide coaching assistance services of Michael Kim, including advice on
project management, technique and tool demonstrations and tool application training;
(c) provide Microsoft training for Places Program staff; and
(d) be available to meet at reasonable times with Philip Morris representatives at
Philip Morris headquarters or at other locations designated by Philip Morris.
Payment.
